spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: when i|was|still unawakened but intent on awakening—i too
entries.description: when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I too
entries.subject: when I
entries.object: still unawakened but intent on awakening—I too

spans.text: Mendicants, before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I too, being liable to be reborn, sought what is also liable to be reborn.

entries.task_id: kiṁ nu|kho|ahaṁ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṁyeva pariyesāmi
entries.description: kiṁ nu kho ahaṁ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṁyeva pariyesāmi
entries.subject: kiṁ nu
entries.object: ahaṁ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṁyeva pariyesāmi

spans.text: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi: Then it occurred to me: ‘kiṁ nu kho ahaṁ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṁyeva pariyesāmi, attanā jarādhammo samāno …pe…

So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso, bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṁ mātāpitūnaṁ assumukhānaṁ rudantānaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajiṁ.
So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, nacirasseva khippameva taṁ dhammaṁ sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṁ.

entries.task_id: so|evaṁ|pabbajito samāno kiṅkusalagavesī anuttaraṁ santivarapadaṁ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṁ
entries.description: So evaṁ pabbajito samāno kiṅkusalagavesī anuttaraṁ santivarapadaṁ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṁ
entries.subject: So
entries.object: pabbajito samāno kiṅkusalagavesī anuttaraṁ santivarapadaṁ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṁ

spans.text: So evaṁ pabbajito samāno kiṅkusalagavesī anuttaraṁ santivarapadaṁ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṁ.

Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi: Then it occurred to me, ‘na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā; ‘It’s not just Āḷāra Kālāma who has faith, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi vīriyaṁ, mayhampatthi vīriyaṁ; energy, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi sati, mayhampatthi sati; mindfulness, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi samādhi, mayhampatthi samādhi; immersion, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi paññā, mayhampatthi paññā.
